label: Ink and watercolour
description: A loose ink line over bleeding watercolour washes: airy and elegant, with the white of the paper breathing through.
suits: reflection, nature, travel, literature, calm channels
image: loose ink-line drawing with transparent watercolour washes, pigment blooming and bleeding at the edges, plenty of white paper showing through, expressive varied line weight, elegant economy of detail
light: airy natural daylight suggested by untouched white paper
camera: calm and floating: slow drifts, gentle tilts, lingering holds
motion: delicate hand-drawn animation: washes gently shimmer and bloom, the ink line boils very slightly, soft natural movement
avoid: photorealism, 3D render, heavy opaque colour, hard vector shapes
